picks.title: Binance says hackers used fake job interview, internal AI tool in $6.3 billion breach
picks.summary: Binance s incident report said hackers used a fake job interview and an internal AI tool to gain access to systems involved in the theft.

picks.title: AI chip smugglers exploit trade control loophole to bring banned HBM from South Korea into China — expensive memory chips packaged with cheap, unsanctioned processors to become legal exports
picks.summary: Customs authorities only check the performance specifications of a server s processors, allowing smugglers to attach high-end memory chips to low-end processors and ship them into China.
